name: pyplex
description: Make images, videos, music and voice with Pyplex's 900+ AI models from chat — exact price first, nothing charged without your yes.

interface.shortDescription: AI images, videos and audio from chat
interface.longDescription: Connect Pyplex and ask for what you want: edit your photo, turn it into a video, make music or a voice-over, or a whole Reel, ad or story planned like a professional editor would. The assistant picks one of 900+ models, writes the prompt, shows the exact price and starts only after you agree. Results stay in your Pyplex Library.
defaultPrompt: Put a red sports car behind me in this photo
Turn my last Pyplex image into a 5 second video
Make a 30 second upbeat background track for a product video
Plan and make a 20 second Reel for my café
